description: Use for the lifespan and recorded border changes of a named state or empire. Matches names and Wikidata labels or aliases by case-insensitive substring, or matches a Wikidata QID. Returns matching polities with dated snapshots, bounding boxes and links. Multiple matches can share a name; a Wikidata QID helps disambiguate. Zero matches means the catalogue found no record. For polities with documented borders in a given year, use world_at_year.

lang.description: Site language for returned page and map links. Use the language the user is writing in.

limit.description: Maximum results to return in this page.

offset.description: Pass the previous result’s next_offset with the same filters to continue.

query.description: Name, e.g. "Ottoman", or a QID, e.g. "Q12560".

name: find_polity

next_offset.description: Offset for the next page with the same filters, or null at the end.

bbox.description: Bounding box [west, south, east, north] in degrees.

returned.description: Number of records in this page.
